references: Siemens SIMATIC S7 SCL V5.3 Reference Manual
OMAC PackML / ISA-88 State Machine standard
Schlenker REV12 Manifest and Merge Register

clarity.description: How clear, specific, and unambiguous the user prompt is. A vague prompt produces unreliable agent output.
criteria: States the target file, block, or function by name (e.g., FB_MainState, 10A_FB_DoorAccess.scl)
Specifies the desired outcome explicitly (add, remove, modify, review, explain)
Provides necessary context (revision, REV11/REV12, GX Works2 vs TIA Portal)
Avoids pronouns like 'it', 'that', 'this' without clear referents
Includes acceptance criteria or a definition of done when requesting changes
Single, coherent intent — not two separate tasks merged in one sentence

score_anchors.1: Completely vague — no file, no target, no desired outcome. e.g. 'fix the problem'
score_anchors.2: Identifies a general area but missing target and outcome. e.g. 'do something with the door logic'
score_anchors.3: Has a target OR an outcome but not both. e.g. 'review FB_DoorAccess' (no criteria) or 'add safety check' (no file)
score_anchors.4: Has target and outcome; minor ambiguity in scope or acceptance criteria
score_anchors.5: Fully specified: named target, explicit outcome, clear acceptance criteria, single intent

safety_compliance.description: Whether the prompt respects Schlenker AGENTS.md safety policy for GX Works2, PLC writes, and source protection.
hard_violations: Requests writing to, downloading to, or programming a real PLC without explicit authorization naming the target and operation
Requests opening or editing D:\GX Works\schlenker.gxw (the protected original) directly
Requests any Online, Monitor, Read from PLC, Write to PLC, Transfer, or Remote Operation without a current-run operator confirmation
Requests a PLC run/stop/reset, connection change, or device-memory write without explicit authorization
Requests saving production credentials, PLC IPs, or connection details to the repository
Requests bypassing the SHA-256 integrity check on the original source file
Requests adding input, activation, click, type, or clipboard behavior to the capture helper script
soft_violations: Reuses a previous disconnection confirmation without requesting a fresh one
Refers to an ambiguous PLC target that could be production
Omits the mandatory change-log entry mention for file-modifying tasks
Asks to skip or abbreviate the baseline compile step before making changes
compliant_patterns: Explicitly references a fresh operator disconnection confirmation
Records original SHA-256 hash before and after changes
Targets REV12 SCL files under REV12/PLC_Sources/ for TIA Portal development
Requests write-change-log.ps1 to be called for file-modifying tasks
Asks for compile verification before and after changes

score_anchors.1: Hard violation present — prompt would directly trigger a forbidden action
score_anchors.2: Multiple soft violations or one soft violation that implies a likely hard violation
score_anchors.3: One soft violation; no hard violations
score_anchors.4: Fully compliant with AGENTS.md; minor policy detail omitted (e.g., didn't mention change log)
score_anchors.5: Fully compliant and explicitly references the relevant safety gate, integrity check, or policy clause

scl_plc_specificity.description: Whether the prompt uses correct IEC 61131-3 / Siemens SCL / Mitsubishi GX Works2 terminology and references real project artefacts.
iec_61131_3_constructs: VAR, VAR_INPUT, VAR_OUTPUT, VAR_IN_OUT, VAR_TEMP, VAR_STAT
TON, TOF, TP (IEC timer function blocks)
CTU, CTD, CTUD (IEC counter function blocks)
siemens_tia_specifics: Multi-instance: declaring FB instances inside another FB VAR section
SafetyOK, PilzDeviceOK, AnybusGatewayOK (named signals in DB_Global)
SINAMICS G120C, PNOZmulti 2, IFM AL1403, SMC EX260 (hardware references)
TIA Portal V19, S7-1512C-1 PN, MTP1500 (platform references)
gxworks2_specifics: Ladder Diagram, GX Works2 1.560J, MELSEC-F, FX3G
X, Y, M, T, C, D device types
Device comments, statement, note (GX Works2 comment levels)
red_flags: Mixes Siemens and Mitsubishi addressing without distinguishing them
Uses generic 'variable' instead of specific SCL type
Refers to 'the PLC code' without naming the FB, DB, or OB
References Schenker (wrong spelling) instead of Schlenker

score_anchors.1: No domain terminology — reads like a generic software request with no PLC/SCL context
score_anchors.2: Generic PLC references but no project-specific artefacts or IEC 61131-3 constructs
score_anchors.3: Uses correct PLC/SCL terms but doesn't reference specific project files, FBs, or signals
score_anchors.4: References specific project artefacts (e.g., FB_DoorAccess, DB_Global.SafetyOK) with correct terminology
score_anchors.5: Precisely references the correct artefact, revision, SCL construct, and any relevant signal path

agents_md_adherence.description: Whether the prompt aligns with the workflow rules defined in Schlenker AGENTS.md: Computer Use contract, evidence requirements, change-log policy, and test evidence rules.
mandatory_workflow_rules: Use computer-use skill through its official wrapper for GX Works2 GUI actions
Require exactly one GX Works2 target window before acting
Observe state before each action and refresh immediately after
For Windows 10: use capture-gxworks2-window.ps1 as read-only visual channel only
Save screenshots, action summaries, compiler output, and report under runs/<run-id>/
Record original SHA-256 hash before and after every run
Append a change-log entry via write-change-log.ps1 for every file-modifying task
Baseline compile must pass before making changes
TIA Portal source import order: UDT types first, then FBs, then DBs, then OBs
evidence_requirements: Compiler evidence (pass/fail + error count) saved to runs/<run-id>/
Before/after screenshots at material UI transitions

score_anchors.1: Prompt would produce an output that directly violates AGENTS.md workflow rules
score_anchors.2: Prompt ignores mandatory evidence or change-log requirements
score_anchors.3: Prompt is generally aligned but omits one mandatory workflow step
score_anchors.4: Prompt follows AGENTS.md workflow; minor omission in evidence or log specification
score_anchors.5: Prompt explicitly references and follows all relevant AGENTS.md workflow steps

overall_score.formula: weighted_average of all four dimension scores

1.0_to_1.9.label: REJECT
1.0_to_1.9.action: Block or strongly warn — prompt will likely produce a harmful or useless result

2.0_to_2.9.label: POOR
2.0_to_2.9.action: Significant clarification required before the agent can safely proceed

3.0_to_3.9.label: FAIR
3.0_to_3.9.action: Proceed with caution — agent should ask one clarifying question before acting

4.0_to_4.4.label: GOOD
4.0_to_4.4.action: Proceed — prompt is clear and compliant; minor suggestions only

4.5_to_5.0.label: EXCELLENT
4.5_to_5.0.action: Proceed confidently — prompt is a model example for this domain

bonus_signals.description: Presence of these patterns in the prompt adds +0.1 to the overall score (max +0.3)
patterns: Explicitly references a currently open AGENTS.md policy clause by name
Provides a TIA Portal import order or GX Works2 procedure sequence
Includes a safety-gate confirmation statement inline
References the REV11-to-REV12 merge register for open items
Mentions specific fault mask, alarm ID, or bilingual HMI text key

penalty_signals.description: Presence of these patterns in the prompt subtracts from the relevant dimension score
